name: image-generate
title_zh: 科研配图专用：机制图、封面、海报，不碰数据图
tagline_zh: 写一句描述就出论文级机制图/封面/海报，绕开通用AI的生图味。只认BioDSH里配好的图像服务，不折腾第三方key。
tagline_en: Turn a text prompt into publication-ready schematics, covers, and posters. Uses your BioDSH-configured image.
desc_en: Generate scientific illustrations (graphical abstracts, mechanism schematics, cover art, poster art) from a text prompt through the image provider configured in the BioDSH app. Not for data plots.
why_zh: 它把「科研视觉」从通用生图里单独拎出来，提示词结构、风格约束都按论文配图调过，出图更贴学术语境。
why_en: Isolates scientific visuals from generic image generation, with prompt structure and style constraints tuned for academic.
limit_zh: 只出概念性示意图（机制、封面、海报），不做数据曲线/统计图；依赖BioDSH应用内已配置的图像服务。
limit_en: Only conceptual illustrations (schematics, covers, posters), no data plots. Requires image provider configured in BioDSH app; no keys or models.
